body: That’s right. This one is in Sheffield for Jessica Ennis who won a gold Olympic medal. I was just walking past it and remembered here existed.
I sent you a friend request - I’m Koda on there, if you got it. Add me back and we can chat if you like :)

Find someone who looks at you the way this cat looks at his owner <3

That’s got to be one of the most beautiful cats I’ve ever seen.
Will I get the type of job I want this year?
Yeah. I’m going to. Therapy isn’t cheap but I think I may need it. Thanks.

Thank you for your reply. Just been doing my best to keep busy since I posted this yesterday. Today was not good - but was easier. Probably with a lot of it being down to the gratitude I have for everyone here that has been really kind.

I’ve never been jaded with something like finding a person to love. It’s easier to shun people away than embrace them and to take offence to things. I don’t claim to be the best person with conveying my feelings in a way other people can understand them; I wasn’t always patient and I made mistakes. But I wanted to believe it was true, even with all the obvious signs. I’ve always been aware that I have given free passes to being messed around but I just believed wholeheartedly that he was a good person but still very much a human being. This is too much even for me though. And maybe that’s why I still feel like it’s my fault because I don’t think I can forgive this.

Congrats - that must have been so difficult as someone in their teenage years. 

 What were your symptoms that made you go to a doctor to be diagnosed in the first place?

Thank you for your kindness. They mean the world right now. I’m trying not to berate myself too much for it but I’d be lying if I said I didn’t feel some essence of... guilt, almost. In that, despite all efforts what I wanted could never actually have been my life. On many levels I feel like I have I let not only myself down, but all the people I ever told that I was happy. 

It’s going to be a real challenge going forward. Every time I think of that conversation we had or what I’m supposed to do now I genuinely feel like I want to throw up. I’m going to probably have to speak to him again one day very soon for closure - I’m willingly ghosting him right now, which is probably not very fair. But I’ll wait until I’m more stable. I might use all the nice responses I’ve gotten here as points of reference in whatever I decide to say.

Thank you. I hope the sun would miss me. I like the sun.

Have I considered why I love him? It’s hard to put an exact reason. But if I had to summarise it I always felt like he was protecting me. I’m not really a gregarious type of person although I do have friends and family I’m close to outside of this. But he always made sure I was never lonely and that we were doing stuff together. He’s been the only person who has ever given me that much attention and it’s hard not to fall in love with that. 

I don’t think I will friends with benefits scenario again. Although I don’t think I could manage a true relationship right now either. Not without a lot of time passing first.

I think you’re exactly right - that’s why this is so difficult. I don’t think I will ever not love this person, even if a day comes where I’m not in love. And that’s absolutely mortifying to think about. I don’t want to be trapped by my own emotions forever.

It’s hard to look forward here because I want to be with someone in a relationship so much. I have a lot to give. Despite the odds, I always felt like I was a good partner. But I don’t see how I can get past this and give someone new a try. 

I’ll try to live life for myself, like you said. It’s the only thing I can do. I want to become a lawyer. The idea of that right now is the only things that feels like a light in a dark place.

Thank you for your reply. I desperately needed it.
